title: Keyturn Trip Booking: Vehicle Listing State and the Guest's Open Reservations at Confirmation
content:
The reservations a guest holds at once are read as one portfolio, not one at a time. A Keyturn Trip Booking reservation is confirmed only while the vehicle's listing is live on the marketplace, so a vehicle that has been snoozed, suspended or delisted cannot take a new confirmation however far in advance the request was made.

The number of reservations a guest may hold simultaneously in the requested, booked or in-progress states is capped per rate plan, and a request that would take the guest past that cap is left unconfirmed until one of the existing reservations settles or is cancelled.

Two reservations the same guest holds must be separated by the overlap buffer of the higher-ranked of the two plans, measured between the scheduled return of the earlier and the scheduled start of the later; reservations that overlap or fall inside that buffer cannot both be confirmed.

Where the guest already holds a reservation on the same vehicle over overlapping dates, the second reservation is refused outright rather than buffered, because one vehicle cannot serve two trips at once.

### The listing-state condition

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| What must hold at confirmation? | The vehicle's listing is live on the marketplace. |
| Which states are not live? | Snoozed, suspended and delisted. |
| What settles the question? | The listing status the marketplace's own vehicle records show for the vehicle the reservation names. |
| Whose word is taken? | The system record, not the account of either party. |
| When is it read? | Before the reservation is confirmed. |
| Does long notice help? | No. However far in advance the request was made, a vehicle that is not live cannot take a new confirmation. |

### Applying the portfolio conditions

The cap and the buffer are separate conditions and both must be satisfied. The cap counts the guest's reservations standing in the requested, booked or in-progress states against the figure their rate plan carries; a reservation that has settled or been cancelled no longer counts against it, which is what releases the guest to have the pending request confirmed.

The buffer is not read from the plan of the reservation being confirmed but from the higher-ranked of the two plans in question, and it is measured from the scheduled return of the earlier reservation to the scheduled start of the later. Two reservations whose dates overlap, and two whose dates fall inside that buffer, are alike in that they cannot both be confirmed.

Where the overlap is on one and the same vehicle, the buffer is not reached at all: the later reservation is refused outright.
